steps.what: Read actual teaching, internship or research work and its requirements
Observe or discuss progress and capture actual feedback needs
Write the assigned supervision feedback and action record
Check the full supervision record and save it

tasks.design: Use the native placement or research-supervision record in {LMS} to retain student and assignment references. Keep reading, supervision and all substantive feedback human; remove only repeated reference entry from the separate written record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated student and placement references are entered in successive supervision records.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing progress in original research or unfamiliar workplace settings.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student's reasoning and intervene appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Minor reduction in record entry, with supervisory and assessment rights unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native supervision forms can reuse assignment references but cannot create observed progress or substantive feedback.

assumptions: Provisional shares include actual assigned supervision records; no new reporting duty is created. Formal grading and registry publication are separate tasks, not omitted work credited here.

The course or placement administration supplies student identifier, assignment and placement reference. s1 verifies those; s2 captures actual progress and feedback facts. Missing references require manual entry in s3.
Try the native record first. Only 1.5 points of reference entry disappear; all reading, observation, feedback writing, final checking and ordinary author save remain ungated.
This is an actual supervision instance, not the same fieldwork instance counted again under laboratory supervision.
unknowns: Whether assignment references already populate the supervision record
Actual ownership of internship feedback records
research_questions: Does a real supervision record require repeated assignment references?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 times 10%=1.5, less 0.4 upkeep gives 1.1. An external internship with an unfamiliar record layout retains assignment entry, leaving only 0.5 point of reusable student references and 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Revise geography curricula and teaching methods

steps.what: Review learning evidence, discipline developments and curriculum constraints
Choose content, learning progression and instructional changes
Write revised course content and learning activities
Apply repeated page structure and insert checked course references
Check the complete revised material and save the internal version

tasks.design: Test native {DOCS} styles and course templates first, then fill repeated page structure from teacher-written content and checked course metadata. Retain curriculum evaluation, pedagogy, original teaching content and the full internal revision check; no model selects learning outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated formatting and course-reference placement can consume manual revision time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native styles or deterministic document assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Designing a coherent learning progression and evaluating whether geography teaching methods work.
tasks.human_edge: Connect discipline understanding with the needs of the actual cohort.
tasks.altitude: Less formatting, with pedagogical judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic document assembly can format teacher-authored course content without choosing its pedagogy.

assumptions: Provisional shares concern actual curriculum revision through an internal checked version, not its formal committee adoption or student publication. Add those real actions and approvals where assigned.

Curriculum administration provides course code, version and required sections; s1 verifies them and supplies course metadata. s2 makes revision decisions and s3 produces all teaching content. Missing content remains teacher work.

Test native styles and templates first. The ten removable points are actual repeated formatting only; existing automatic layout and computational runtime have no baseline. Same-system save stays fully retained in s5 without a gate.
unknowns: Amount of manual formatting remaining after native styles
research_questions: Can the current course layout be reproduced without changing any teacher-authored content?

incremental.description: Maintain course document mappings and layout checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 formatting points less 1 upkeep gives 9. A new field-course structure has little reusable layout; only 2 points of course-reference placement disappear, leaving 1 net. All new pedagogical content remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Discuss students' actual questions and explain or advise in person
Write and save any actual follow-up commitments in existing notes

tasks.design: Keep office-hour explanation and advice with the teacher, with actual follow-up writing separated in {DOCS}. A native short-note template is assessed, but this scenario's notes already contain only fresh commitments and no repeated fields to eliminate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is actual student explanation and fresh follow-up capture rather than repeated administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing short notes already provide the relevant native support; no additional change is justified.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosing a student's misunderstanding or personal constraint.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt an explanation and respond to what the student is reluctant to say.
tasks.altitude: No change to the teacher's week or advising authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: office-hour advice depends on student context, and fresh short commitments still need actual capture.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for an office-hour encounter with an actual follow-up note. No mandatory new record is introduced; encounters without a note remove and reweight s2.
s1 produces the actual question, advice and commitment facts, with capture included in s1 and s2. No structured record is assumed to pre-exist the discussion.

Record, lookup and send boundaries were inspected: actual follow-up writing is s2; this encounter has no separate repeat lookup, booking or outbound message. The standing office-hour schedule is not reconfigured per visit and creates no invented preparation baseline.

A native note template cannot supply this scenario's fresh advice or commitments; the already short note and ordinary ungated author save remain fully retained. Any observed written follow-up send must be separately modelled before extending this estimate.
No implementation or incremental upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Whether actual encounters contain a repeated lookup or outbound follow-up
Proportion of encounters with a real follow-up note
research_questions: Observe an office-hour encounter and isolate any actual lookup, note or send before confirming zero saving.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 90 discussion points and 10 fresh-note points remain. For a drop-in with no follow-up commitment, the reweighted task is entirely live advice and still zero; no calendar-setup saving or extra record is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise geography laboratory and field work

steps.what: Review the actual exercise, field conditions and supervision requirements
Observe students, intervene and capture actual laboratory or field observations
Write, check and save the actual supervision record

tasks.design: Use an exercise-specific record form in {LMS} to retain the course and exercise reference. Keep all live supervision, actual observation capture, written findings and their complete check with the teacher; ordinary author saves remain ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exercise references are repeatedly entered into supervision records.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe activity, flawed sampling or a student's misunderstanding in real time.
tasks.human_edge: Intervene in the actual laboratory or field situation.
tasks.altitude: Minor reduction in reference entry; physical supervision stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exercise defaults reuse record references without observing students or assessing field technique.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover an actual exercise and its assigned supervision record, excluding formal grades. An institution with no such record must remove and reweight s3 rather than create a duty.

Course staff supply the exercise identifier and current plan before s1. s2 captures actual student activity, site and follow-up facts; missing facts remain manual. s3 includes all fresh writing and its check.
Native forms are tested first. Only 1.5 points of repeated course/exercise reference entry disappear. Existing automatic defaults and runtime earn no saving; ordinary save is retained.
Do not add this instance to the same supervision instance in the broader undergraduate supervision task.
unknowns: Actual laboratory versus field record requirements
research_questions: Which course references does the teacher still repeat while writing actual observations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 times 10%=1.5, less 0.4 upkeep gives 1.1. An unfamiliar field exercise needs manual exercise and site references, leaving just 0.5 point of course-reference reuse and 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain student advice, supervision and curriculum judgement while reducing actual repeated formatting or record references.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish fresh observations from reusable record fields
role.ambitious_version: Use verified preparation savings for clearer field explanations, without automating student decisions.
